calculators.title_en: Austria Gross to Net Salary Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie Ihr monatliches und jährliches Nettogehalt in Österreich unter Berücksichtigung von 14 Monatsgehältern (Sonderzahlungen 13. & 14. Gehalt), Sozialversicherung, Familienbonus Plus und Pendlerpauschale.
calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Monthly Salary (12x standard payments + 2x special payments 13th/14th salary). Employee Social Security (SV-Beitrag): ~18.12% for employees (Pension 10.25%, Health 3.87%, Unemployment 0%-3% based on income bracket, Chamber fee 0.5%, Housing fee 0.5%). Taxable Base (Lohnsteuerbemessungsgrundlage) = Gross - SV - Pendlerpauschale. Income tax is calculated on regular monthly pay using progressive tax brackets (0% up to €13,539/yr, 20% to €21,992, 30% to €36,458, 40% to €70,365, 48% to €104,859, 50% to €1M). Special payments (13th/14th salary: Urlaubs- & Weihnachtsgeld) are taxed separately: first €620 tax-free per year, next tranche up to Jahressechstel taxed at a flat 6% rate. Tax reductions: Verkehrsabsetzbetrag (€496/yr), Pendlereuro (€6/km simple commute per year), Familienbonus Plus (€2,000/yr per child <18, €700/yr per child ≥18), and AVAB/AEAB. Net Annual Salary = Total Gross - Total SV - Total Tax.

calculators.title_en: Austria Self-Employed SVS Social Security & Tax Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie die voraussichtlichen SVS-Sozialversicherungsbeiträge (Pensions-, Kranken-, Unfallversicherung) und die Einkommensteuer für Gewerbetreibende und Neue Selbstständige in Österreich inklusive Gewinnfreibetrag.
calculators.formula_explanation: Net Profit (Gewinn) = Annual Revenue - Operating Expenses. SVS Social Security Base (Beitragsgrundlage) = Net Profit + SVS contributions paid. SVS Contribution Rates: Health Insurance (Krankenversicherung) 6.80%, Pension Insurance (Pensionsversicherung) 18.50%, Voluntary Self-Employed Provident Fund (Selbstständigenvorsorge) 1.53%, Accident Insurance (Unfallversicherung) flat ~€11.35/month (€136.20/yr). Minimum monthly threshold (Mindestbeitragsgrundlage) applies if profit is below minimum limit. Profit Tax Allowance (Gewinnfreibetrag - GFB): Grundfreibetrag is automatically 15% on profits up to €33,000 (max €4,950 tax exemption without investment proof). Profit above €33,000 gets an additional investment-based GFB (13% up to €178,000, 7% up to €300,000, 4.5% up to €580,000) matched by eligible investments. Taxable Income = Profit - SVS Contributions - Gewinnfreibetrag. Personal income tax is calculated via Austrian tax brackets.

calculators.title_en: Austria Property Transfer Tax & Registration Fees Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie alle Kaufnebenkosten beim Immobilienkauf in Österreich: Grunderwerbsteuer (GrESt), Grundbuchseintragungsgebühr, Pfandrechtsintabulierung und Notar-/Rechtsanwaltskosten inklusive Befreiungen für das erste Eigenheim.
calculators.formula_explanation: Property Transfer Tax (Grunderwerbsteuer - GrESt): For standard third-party purchases, flat 3.5% of purchase price. For family transfers (Stufentarif): 0.5% for first €250,000 of value, 2.0% for next €150,000 (up to €400k), 3.5% above €400,000. Land Register Registration Fee (Grundbuchseintragungsgebühr): 1.1% of purchase price for ownership entry. Mortgage Registration Fee (Pfandrechtsintabulierung): 1.2% of mortgage loan amount. First Home Exemption (Eigenheimbefreiung 2024-2026): 0% Grundbuch and Pfandrecht fees for primary residences on amounts up to €500,000 (amounts between €500k and €2M taxed only on excess over €500k). Notary/Legal contract setup (Vertragserrichtung & Treuhandabwicklung): typically 1.5% to 2.5% + 20% USt. Realtor commission (Maklerprovision): 3.0% + 20% USt = 3.6% total.

calculators.title_en: Austria GmbH & FlexCo Corporate Tax & Dividend Calculator
calculators.description_native: Vergleichen Sie die Steuerbelastung und den Nettozufluss für Gesellschafter-Geschäftsführer bei GmbH und FlexCo in Österreich durch Optimierung zwischen Geschäftsführer-Gehalt, Körperschaftsteuer (KöSt 23%) und KESt-Ausschüttung (27,5%).
calculators.formula_explanation: Company Taxable Profit = EBIT - Director Salary (inclusive of employer social security & municipal tax Kommunalsteuer 3% + DB/DZ payroll taxes). Corporate Income Tax (Körperschaftsteuer - KöSt): 23% flat on taxable corporate profit. Minimum Corporate Tax (Mindest-KöSt): €500/year for first 5 years for foundation-privileged GmbH/FlexCo (€125/quarter), thereafter €1,750/year (€437.50/quarter). Retained Profit after KöSt can be paid out as dividends (Ausschüttung). Capital Gains Tax on Dividends (Kapitalertragsteuer - KESt): 27.5% flat rate withheld at source. Total effective dividend tax burden on corporate profit = 23% KöSt + (77% * 27.5% KESt) = 44.175% overall tax rate on retained corporate earnings. Director Salary portion is taxed at employee/ASVG level or GSVG self-employed level depending on shareholding percentage (>50% ownership = GSVG + regular income tax scale).

calculators.title_en: Austria Severance Pay & Unused Vacation Payout Calculator
calculators.description_native: Berechnen Sie Ihre Ansprüche bei Beendigung des Dienstverhältnisses in Österreich: Abfertigung Neu (Mitarbeitervorsorgekasse MVK), Urlaubsersatzleistung und aliquote Sonderzahlungen (13. & 14. Gehalt).
calculators.formula_explanation: Abfertigung Neu (MVK): Employer pays 1.53% of monthly gross salary (including special payments) into an employee pension fund (Mitarbeitervorsorgekasse). Entitlement for cash payout requires 3 years of contributions AND termination by employer, mutual consent, or retirement (no cash payout on voluntary resignation by employee, but capital stays in fund). Cash payout is taxed at a privileged flat rate of 6% (or 0% if rolled into pension). Abfertigung Alt: Staggered payout multiplier based on years of service (3 yrs = 2 months salary, 5 yrs = 3 months, 10 yrs = 4 months, 15 yrs = 6 months, 20 yrs = 9 months, 25 yrs = 12 months salary). Taxed at 6% privileged tax rate under § 67 EStG up to statutory caps. Unused Vacation Payout (Urlaubsersatzleistung): Calculates daily gross compensation = (Monthly Gross * 14 / 12) / 21.75 * Unused Days, subject to regular SV and wage tax. Aliquote Sonderzahlungen: Prorated 13th (Urlaubsgeld) and 14th (Weihnachtsgeld) salary calculated based on months worked in the current calendar year.
